items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-05-29
items.q: I've never heard of Cuban Bennett.

ctx.x: Well, Alvin told me that he liked Cuban Bennett a lot.

That's the fellow I'm referring to, but I've never heard of Cuban Bennett. But they claim he had this type of trumpet that he played. Well, if Billy Douglas copied it, he did an awful, tremendous job of copying so much.
One more, maybe. See what's next. We'll have time for one more.
